import os
from azure.monitor.query import MetricsQueryClient, MetricAggregationType
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential

# Initialize the client
credential = DefaultAzureCredential()
client = MetricsQueryClient(credential)

def query_metric_window(metric_name, start_time, end_time):
    query = client.query_metric(
        metric_names=[metric_name],
        resource_uri=os.getenv('AZURE_RESOURCE_URI'),
        timespan=(start_time, end_time),
        aggregations=[MetricAggregationType.AVERAGE]
    )
    data_points = [point for point in query.metrics[0].time_series[0].data]
    return data_points

        timespan=(start_time, end_time),

    }
    return stats

def compare_metric_series(metric_name, start_time, end_time, dimension_name, dimension_value1, dimension_value2):
    query1 = client.query_metric(
        metric_names=[metric_name],
        resource_uri=os.getenv('AZURE_RESOURCE_URI'),
        timespan=(start_time, end_time),
        aggregations=[MetricAggregationType.AVERAGE],
        filter=f"{dimension_name} eq '{dimension_value1}'"
    )
    query2 = client.query_metric(
        metric_names=[metric_name],
        resource_uri=os.getenv('AZURE_RESOURCE_URI'),
        timespan=(start_time, end_time),
        aggregations=[MetricAggregationType.AVERAGE],
        filter=f"{dimension_name} eq '{dimension_value2}'"
    )
    series1 = [point.average for point in query1.metrics[0].time_series[0].data]
    series2 = [point.average for point in query2.metrics[0].time_series[0].data]
    return series1, series2

import os
from azure.monitor.query import MetricsQueryClient, MetricAggregationType
from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential
from observability_client import get_metrics_client, get_resource_uri
from observability_models import MetricDataPoint, MetricSeries

def metric_summary(metric_name, start_time, end_time):
    client = get_metrics_client()
    query = client.query_metric(
        metric_names=[metric_name],
        resource_uri=get_resource_uri(),
        timespan=(start_time, end_time),
        aggregations=[MetricAggregationType.AVERAGE]
    )
    data_points = [MetricDataPoint(point.timestamp, point.average) for point in query.metrics[0].time_series[0].data]
    series = MetricSeries(metric_name, data_points)
    return series
